## Recommended equipment: {#recommended-equipment .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- [CAN-USB interface (VCI)](https://store.boschrexroth.com/Mobilelektronik-und-Telematik/BODAS-Hardware/Zubeh%C3%B6r?cclcl=en_DE){.weblink target="_blank"}

- [Lab-Wiring RC40](https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/de/search.html?q=95482&lang=EN&origin=header&num=10&s=download){.weblink target="_blank"}

- Stabilized power supply with nominal 12V or 24V output voltage

 

For a smooth start, we recommend to purchase a [starter kit](https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/de/search.html?_3_vocabId_4354720=4677637&q=%2295227%22&s=download&c=de&lang=en&num=10){.weblink target="_blank"} for BODAS controllers RC of series 4x, which includes:

- RC4x

- License for BODAS-service 4.x

- Laboratory cable RC4x for connecting the control unit to supply voltage and CAN bus or Ethernet

- CAN-USB adapter (VCI)

## Additional equipment: {#additional-equipment .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- [BODAS test box TB3](https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/de/search.html?_3_vocabId_4354720=4677637&q=%2295092%22&s=download&c=de&lang=en&num=10){.weblink target="_blank"}

- [BODAS measuring adapter MA series 10](https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/de/search.html?_3_vocabId_4354720=4677637&q=%2295090%22&s=download&c=de&lang=en&num=10){.weblink target="_blank"}

- [Configured wiring harness with connector](https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/de/search.html?q=95482&lang=EN&origin=header&num=10&s=download){.weblink target="_blank"}
